scene_prompt: Eye-level close-up of a young woman with soft features and heavy-lidded eyes. She lies on her bed on her stomach, chin resting on folded arms, looking directly into the camera — expression completely flat, eyes doing all the work. Wearing a fitted white baby tee cropped above the navel, black thigh-highs disappearing under the hem of a tiny plaid mini skirt. Bare feet kicked up behind her. Underneath her — rumpled pastel bedding. Behind her — bedroom wall with neon LED strips casting the room in soft pink-purple, anime posters on the wall, a controller on the nightstand. Shot on a Contax T2, Kodak Ektar 100, 38mm f/2.8, shallow depth of field, rich analog texture. Keep her face, hair, and body exactly the same.
caption: it's just a costume 🎮🙈
